# Rihlatul Hudah

> A comprehensive Islamic knowledge hub: read the Quran with translation and tafsir, study Hadith, learn the 99 Names of Allah, find duas and prayer times, and follow guides for new Muslims.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview, daily ayat, continue reading, and quick navigation.
- [Quran](/quran): Browse all 114 Surahs with Arabic, translation, and tafsir.
- [Popular Verses](/popular): Curated, frequently recited verses.
- [Hadith](/hadith): Authentic Hadith collections (Bukhari, Muslim, and more).
- [Duas](/duas): Authentic supplications by category.
- [99 Names of Allah](/names): Asma ul Husna with meanings and explanations.
- [Prayer Times](/prayer-times): Accurate prayer times and Qibla direction.
- [Dhikr Counter](/dhikr): Digital dhikr counter for daily remembrance.
- [Learning](/learning): Structured Islamic lessons with quizzes.
- [Yasarna Quran](/yasarna): Learn to read Arabic and the Quran from scratch.
- [Islamic Calendar](/calendar): Hijri calendar with events and Ramadan tracking.
- [Guides](/guides): Step-by-step guides for new Muslims (wudu, salah, more).
- [Support](/support): Support the mission via donations.
